title: ABB中国总裁韩辉：二季度产量创历史新高，2026年能否延续这一势头？
speaker: Henry Han

segments.en: I was looking at your earnings your revenue declined in 2024 2025 was flat how are things looking like now is it recovering this year
segments.zh: 我注意到你们的营收在2024年下滑，2025年持平，现在情况如何？今年在复苏吗？

segments.en: yes very much so we just closed our quarter two which is the highest production man a quarter in our history so also now we're in the quarter three we see also demanding pickup we really think we're going to have a fantastic 2026
segments.zh: 是的，我们刚结束的第二季度是历史上产量最高的季度，第三季度需求也在回升，我们相信2026年将非常强劲

segments.en: how are you going to compete against all of these Chinese startups there's so many of them here at WAIC you know whether it's cost customization scale how do you send off the rivals
segments.zh: 面对世界人工智能大会上众多中国初创企业，你们如何在成本、定制化、规模等方面竞争？

segments.en: well that's great to be in this environment our supply chain very localized 180% our parts resource from China and our product 90% delivered to our customer our manufacturer in our Shanghai
segments.zh: 这个环境很好，我们的供应链高度本地化，80%的零部件来自中国，90%的产品交付给中国客户，在上海制造

segments.en: so this is the environment to be in this business so it's definitely a furious competition but ABB bringing you know a more than 50 years expertise in the motion control you know coupled our latest AI technology with development internally and also work with our partners locally and internationally
segments.zh: 竞争确实激烈，但ABB拥有超过50年的运动控制经验，结合内部开发的AI技术以及与本地和国际伙伴的合作

segments.en: so we're very confident we're going to have our next chapter in China are you planning to go into a humanoid robotic well that's a very touchy question you know
segments.zh: 我们非常有信心开启在中国的下一篇章。你们计划进入人形机器人领域吗？这是个敏感问题

segments.en: we have some research into that field for sure but we're not yet developed the so-called two-leg humanoid in the market because our mission is for the industrial automation
segments.zh: 我们确实有一些研究，但尚未开发出双足人形机器人，因为我们的使命是工业自动化
